_doc: Grade presets: ordered FFmpeg filter chains applied per clip after reframing. Keep them conservative. A grade may set mood but must never change the real color of walls, stone, wood or fabric beyond what a viewer would accept as the same material. Per-clip overrides: grade: {preset, exposure (stops), temperature (K), saturation, contrast, vibrance, vignette}.

architectural-neutral.description: True-to-life default for interiors. Clean whites, gentle S-curve, no tint. Use when accuracy matters most.

domus-warm-paper.description: Brand house look: warm parchment highlights, lifted soft blacks, copper-friendly midtones. For brand films, exteriors in sun, lifestyle.

golden-hour.description: Late-sun exterior. Warm and glowing, but skies stay believable.

twilight-blue-hour.description: Dusk exteriors: cool shadows, warm practicals in windows. The classic luxury listing exterior.

apple-minimal.description: Bright, airy, slightly cool-neutral, low saturation. Product-like calm for modern interiors.

editorial-soft.description: Magazine look: muted palette, creamy highlights, matte blacks.

commercial-crisp.description: High-energy social ads: crisp contrast, vibrant but controlled.

documentary-natural.description: Lifestyle and documentary. Minimal intervention, slight warmth.

mono-architectural.description: Black and white for experimental or editorial beats (line, form, shadow). Use sparingly. Never for the hero shot of a listing.
